name: Luma events landing page by lu.ma
description: A single centred column on pure white, led by a display headline whose final line is the page's only loud accent — a pink-to-orange gradient — hovering above a black pill CTA with a soft glow. The page then alternates density: a six-card popular-events row with poster thumbnails and grey metadata, a two-row community grid of icon-chip cards, and a 12-tile category grid where tiny single-pastel line icons carry all the colour. Everything stays flat (1px warm-grey borders, 8–12px radii, no shadows), section headings shrink to small bold left-aligned labels, and the page closes by mirroring the hero — a two-line gradient statement with paired pill buttons — over a hairline footer.
